messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-10-27] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (the search indexer, 2025-10-24). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-12-15] handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction: The 2025-11-18 note about the indexer named the wrong team. The Dune team took it over on that date; the Ember team did not.
- [2025-03-06] incident-review/INC-2025-004: INC-2025-004 review. What happened: notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04. Why: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Follow-up decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-09-18] standup/dune/2025-09-18-2: Farah Haddad is the release captain for Q3 2025.
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15: Lena still has the Boreal pager.
- [2025-03-31] standup/dune/2025-03-31: Farah still has the Dune pager.
- [2025-07-09] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Incident review INC-2025-017. Auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. Root cause: an expired intermediate certificate. Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-04-18] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Incident review INC-2025-011. Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13. Root cause: an index missing after the schema migration. Decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for billing-api: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season). Observation from the Atlas team: after Tuesday's deploy, search-indexer's p99 latency doubled.
